This is external acceptance for the exact signed unpublished candidate89. It does not measure automatic queue coverage. Disposable emulator storage fixtures test upgrade retention only and must never enter coverage totals or product sources.

The workflow verifies pinned baseline88 and candidate89 bytes, package versions and the existing signing certificate, then verifies the actual installed APK bytes after each install. Six independent emulators cover Android11/15/16 and both persisted theme IDs (Aurora Glass visible, saved moss retained with dark rendering). App UID IPv4 and IPv6 OUTPUT DROP rules are verified before rendering cached schedules; radio toggles alone are not treated as offline isolation.

Checks cover 88→89 upgrade, persisted address/manual queue/reminders/cache/source timestamps/theme ID, restart, own confirmation/validation/delete dialogs, manual queue editing and clean startup. PNG/XML pairs and JSON proofs are uploaded for review. Fixture reminder retention does not assert Android notification delivery or live-source behavior. The input helper is the same pinned public QA-only helper previously reviewed for88.

The inherited helper source is included here as external black-box automation; no private app source, signing key or release automation is included. The workflow has read-only repository permission and cannot publish a release or update channel.
